div.div: In an effort to escape the power struggle within the Heavenly Demon Sect, the protagonist Myeong-Un retreats to a life of seclusion. However, simply avoiding ambition for the throne is not enough to avert tragedy. Myeong-Un flees from the sect leader Myeong-Gak, who seeks fratricide, before meeting his demise. At the moment of his death, as his consciousness fades, he hears a voice. "Do you regret it? Do you wish to fight again?"" To his surprise, Myeong-Un, believed to be dead, opens his eyes once more.... (Source: WEBTOON)

In an ancient world where martial artists reign supreme, Un-Seong can only watch as his master is brutally beaten to death after a false accusation of practicing forbidden demonic arts. Even after a valiant fight, he fails to kill those responsible and faces his own end. But fate has other plans… Instead of taking his last breath, he awakens as a child, training to be an elite soldier of a demonic sect. Now Un-Seong must embrace the demonic arts and harness power in his ultimate quest for revenge. (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

div.b: Your fortune: You will meet a dark handsome stranger
